facts.fact: The article says The Gambia has a national EMIS running on DHIS2 built with the education ministry, where data clerks enter the annual census and regional planners use dashboards daily.

systems.owner: Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education

facts.fact: In 2019, with Norad and GPE KIX support, the DHIS2 for Education project started building a new EMIS with MoBSE and HISP WCA.
The DHIS2 EMIS (aggregate data) is listed as in use at national scale since 2019, built on customised aggregate EMIS census forms.
After a 2020 pilot in 200 schools, the ministry scaled the individual learner module to national level in 2021, launching the individual student identification number.
Gambiana reports the education ministry signed an MoU with the health ministry to link its EMIS with the HMIS, verifying school enrolment against national birth records.

systems.owner: Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education

facts.fact: GPE KIX says The Gambia's Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education is integrating individual-level learner and teacher data and has SEMIS pilots.

systems.owner: Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education

facts.fact: DHIS2 says MoBSE's Education Data Centre, on DHIS2-Ed, now gives live dashboards that update as new information flows in, with historical census data migrated into it, replacing paper census forms and yearbooks.
DHIS2 says MoBSE's digital student registry, piloted in 2020 in 200 schools, gives each learner a unique ID and has scaled nationwide, with nearly 80% of Gambian learners included.
